atoms.b: There are ((++three not)) different types of fossils.
((++Imprint Body Trace)) fossils are formed when an organism leaves an imprint in soil or clay. This type of fossil ((contains ++doesn’t_contain)) organic matter.
((Imprint ++Body Trace)) fossils are the remains of actual organisms. These fossils are usually only the ((++hard soft)) bits of an organism, for example shell or bone.
((Imprint Body ++Trace)) fossils record the biological activity of an organism but not preserved remains of the organism.

Imprint fossils are formed from imprints.
Body fossils are formed from the hard bits of organisms.
Trace fossils are recordings of biological activity.
